RECORD: Record RUN/FAULT/COMM status and visible alarm references; do not force I/O or reset faults. ACCEPTANCE: No unexplained faults; capture and escalate any fault rather than clearing it. ACCEPTANCE: No visible damage or missing labels; no energized enclosure access or terminal tightening. Scope: IAB-SKID-01 and applicable child devices.

ACCEPTANCE: No obstruction or deterioration; de-energized cleaning only under an approved procedure. Scope: IAB-SKID-01 and applicable child devices.

Task group name: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
Task description: IAB-SM-S01-M-T05. Review network and operator-interface symptoms. RECORD: Record link alarms; communication interruptions and reported operator issues. ACCEPTANCE: No unexplained communication loss; do not disconnect cables to test. Scope: IAB-SKID-01 and applicable child devices.

Task group name: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
Task description: IAB-SM-S01-M-T06. Inspect visible guarding and E-stop hardware condition. RECORD: Record guard/interlock/E-stop/light-curtain condition where installed; use N/A with a reason otherwise. ACCEPTANCE: No visible damage or bypass indication; functional safety testing is a separate approved procedure. Scope: IAB-SKID-01 and applicable child devices.

Task group name: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
Task description: IAB-SM-S01-M-T07. Record findings and follow-up work. RECORD: Record PASS/FAIL/N/A per task; photos; defect references and technician identity. ACCEPTANCE: Every exception has a follow-up reference; do not claim safety certification. Scope: IAB-SKID-01 and applicable child devices.
